item.title: Qatar takes over air traffic control over international waters in Doha FIR
item.description:
The Qatar Civil Aviation Authority announced on Thursday that Qatar has assumed responsibility for managing air traffic over designated areas of international waters within the Doha Flight Information Region. The step implements ICAO Council Decision C-DEC 234/9 and follows updated air navigation services agreements with neighbouring states, upgraded navigation, surveillance and communication systems, and the qualification of Qatari air traffic controllers.
Sources: The Peninsula https://www.thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/qatar-expands-air-traffic-management-role-over-international-waters-in-doha-fir · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266617/latest-news/qatar-takes-over-air-traffic-management-responsibility-over-international-waters-within-doha-fir · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/قطر-تتولى-إدارة-الحركة-الجوية-فوق-المياه-الدولية-ضمن-إقليم-الدوحة-لمعلومات-الطيران

item.title: QCB extends HIMYAN card acceptance to Oman
item.description:
Qatar Central Bank announced on Thursday the gradual acceptance of the national payment card HIMYAN in Oman, allowing holders to make purchases and cash withdrawals at supported points of sale and ATMs. The expansion adds to existing acceptance in Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait under the Third Financial Sector Strategy.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/qcb-expands-himyan-card-acceptance-to-oman · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/26/11/2026/مصرف-قطر-المركزي-يعلن-عن-قبول-بطاقة-هميان-في-سلطنة-عمان

item.title: WHOOP opens its first international lab and flagship store in Msheireb
item.description:
US human performance technology company WHOOP opened its headquarters in Msheireb Downtown Doha on Wednesday, housing its first research lab outside the United States, its first-ever flagship store and a regional office. The opening was attended by Minister of Public Health Mansoor bin Ebrahim Al Mahmoud and QCB Governor Sheikh Bandar bin Mohammed bin Saoud Al Thani. The project stems from a partnership announced with Invest Qatar in October 2025.
Sources: The Peninsula https://www.thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/whoop-opens-first-international-performance-centre-and-retail-flagship-in-qatar · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738981/qatar/whoop-opens-doha-hq-first-international-performance-lab

item.title: Hajj packages in Qatar range from QR22,000 to QR100,000 with instalments
item.description:
Hajj operators said on the Hiwar Al Watan programme that packages for the 1448 AH season in Qatar range from QR22,000 to QR100,000, depending on accommodation location and category, room occupancy and services, with instalments possible by arrangement. Ibrahim Mohammed Al Naama, head of coordination and follow-up at the Ministry of Awqaf, said prices are lower than elsewhere in the Gulf relative to services, and that the ministry asks operators each year for single, double, triple and quadruple room prices.
Sources: The Peninsula https://www.thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/hajj-packages-in-qatar-range-from-qr22000-to-qr100000-with-instalment-options-available-hajj-operators · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/25/11/2026/الأوقاف-أسعار-حملات-الحج-في-قطر-أقل-من-دول-الخليج-والخدمات-تطورت-بشكل-كبير

item.title: Lusail hosts the Qatar Formula 1 Grand Prix from Friday
item.description:
The Qatar Formula 1 Grand Prix begins on Friday at Lusail International Circuit, the 22nd and penultimate round of the 2026 season, with 22 drivers from 11 teams, a sprint on Saturday evening and the main race on Sunday evening. Italy's Andrea Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes have already secured the drivers' and constructors' titles, while Max Verstappen leads the fight for second place on 304 points after winning in Las Vegas.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/جائزة-قطر-الكبرى-للفورمولا-1-أنتونيللي-يبحث-عن-لقبه-الأول-في-لوسيل-وكسر-احتكار-فيرستابن · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739018/sport/formula-1/formula-1-heads-to-qatar-grand-prix-with-tensions-high-among-drivers

item.title: Qatar face South Korea in basketball qualifier tonight at Al Janoub
item.description:
Qatar's basketball team meets South Korea on Thursday at Al Janoub Arena in the fifth window of the Asian Qualifiers for the 2027 World Cup, before facing Japan at the same venue on Sunday. The team plays the window under new head coach Hatem Mamlouk, who replaced Hakan Demir, and has already qualified for the tournament as host.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739008/sport/qatar-sports/qatar-to-face-south-korea-japan-in-fiba-basketball-world-cup-2027-asian-qualifiers · FIBA https://www.fiba.basketball/en/news/7-cant-miss-games-in-window-5-of-asian-qualifiers

item.title: Met department warns of low coastal visibility on Thursday morning
item.description:
The Qatar Meteorology Department warned of poor horizontal visibility in some coastal areas on Thursday morning due to mist and fog, with moderate daytime temperatures and relatively cold conditions at night. Highs will reach 29°C in Doha, Al Wakrah and Al Khor, with lows falling to 19°C in Abu Samra overnight.
Sources: The Peninsula https://www.thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/fog-to-affect-visibility-in-parts-of-qatar-on-thursday-temperatures-to-reach-29c · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/الأرصاد-الجوية-تحذر-من-رؤية-أفقية-متدنية-على-الساحل

item.title: Saudi air defences intercept two ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh
item.description:
Saudi air defences intercepted two ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh overnight Wednesday into Thursday and destroyed two drones over the Eastern Province, coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki Al Maliki said. A blast was heard around midnight in northern and eastern parts of the capital after a "hostile aerial threat" alert. The attacks follow coalition strikes on Hodeidah port.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666552/saudi-arabia/saudi-air-defenses-intercept-houthi-missiles-and-drones-fired-at-riyadh-eastern-province · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/26/saudi-arabia-intercepts-wave-of-retaliatory-houthi-attacks/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-saudi-arabia-intercepts-missiles-and-drones-as-trump-keeps-iran-options-open-1.500761343 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/26/iran-war-live-explosion-rocks-sanaa-missiles-intercepted-over-riyadh

item.title: Iran threatens to block all regional oil exports if its own are halted
item.description:
Iranian Deputy Parliament Speaker Hamidreza Hajibabaei threatened on Thursday that no oil would leave the region if Iran is prevented from exporting its own, calling the approach "a blockade for a blockade". He warned countries assisting the United States in the Strait of Hormuz of Iranian retaliation and said shipments bypassing the strait to lower prices could become "legitimate targets".
Sources: Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/iran-threatens-to-block-all-regional-oil-exports-if-its-own-shipments-are-halted/ · News.az (Iran International) https://news.az/news/iran-threatens-to-block-all-regional-oil-shipments-if-its-exports-halted

item.title: Dubai awards Dh56.5bn in contracts for Al Maktoum airport
item.description:
Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, announced on Thursday new contracts worth Dh56.5bn ($15.38bn) for the development of Al Maktoum International Airport, taking total contracts awarded to more than Dh80bn. A workforce of 14,000 is on site; the first phase is due to open in 2032 with capacity for 150 million passengers, rising to more than 260 million a year on completion.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/aviation/dubai-awards-dh565-billion-in-contracts-for-al-maktoum-international-airport-1.500761485 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/aviation/2026/11/26/dubai-awards-dh565bn-in-new-contracts-for-al-maktoum-airport/

item.title: UAE plans desalination plants on east coast outside the Gulf
item.description:
UAE Minister of Energy and Infrastructure Suhail Al Mazrouei told the RAK Energy Summit that the country is exploring desalination plants on its east coast outside the Arabian Gulf to diversify water production sites and strengthen water security. He said the concentration of plants in the Gulf is raising salinity and exposing them to pollution risks. The Fujairah I project will produce 60 million gallons a day at a cost of $284.8mn.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/26/uae-explores-water-desalination-plants-on-east-coast-outside-arabian-gulf/ · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/uae-plans-desalination-plants-outside-gulf-to-ensure-sustained-water-supply-says-minister

item.title: Muttrah Teleferik opens as Oman's first public cable car
item.description:
The Muttrah Teleferik tourism project in Muscat Governorate was officially opened under the patronage of Sayyid Saud bin Hilal Al Busaidi, Minister of Culture, Sports and Youth, marking the start of full operations after weeks of soft opening. Developed by Sabeen Investment with Muscat Municipality, it is the first cable car project open to the public in the Sultanate.
Sources: Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179594-muttrah-teleferik-project-officially-opened · Oman Daily https://www.omandaily.om/article/1215654

item.title: Madbouly visits Warraq fire injured, orders replacement cars and investment certificates
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly and the health and social solidarity ministers visited those injured in the Warraq Ring Road fire in hospital on Thursday, relaying President Abdel Fattah El Sisi's directive for immediate support to the injured and victims' families. He tasked Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy with maximum support for those affected, bank investment certificates to secure a stable income, and replacement cars for those whose vehicles burned.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/x/7632934 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195119 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536199

item.title: Health ministry: 19 Warraq fire injured still in hospital, no blood drive needed
item.description:
Health ministry spokesman Hossam Abdel Ghaffar said on Thursday that 19 people injured in the Warraq fire remain in hospital after two were discharged, out of 21 injured and 31 dead. He said the injuries are burns of varying degrees, distributed across hospitals including Sheikh Zayed Specialised and Imbaba General, and that blood stocks are sufficient so no donation drive is needed for now.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/x/7632864 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195087

item.title: Housing minister reviews plan for 1 million homes by 2030 through six programmes
item.description:
Housing Minister Randa El Menshawy held a meeting on Wednesday evening to follow up on delivering 1 million housing units by 2030, in line with President El Sisi's directives announced at Egypt Forum 2026. The strategy rests on six programmes, including social housing through the Social Housing Fund, partnerships with the New Urban Communities Authority and developers, and rental and rent-to-own units.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195098 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536192

item.title: Industry minister discusses new Chinese investment with Zhejiang entrepreneurs
item.description:
Industry Minister Khaled Hashem met a delegation from the Zhejiang Young Entrepreneurs Association, headed by Zhuang Yaozhong, to discuss increasing Chinese investment in Egypt. Talks covered spinning, textiles, advanced fibres, renewable energy, building materials, and engineering and medical industries, and the minister urged Chinese companies to use Egypt's trade agreements to make it a platform for their exports.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195108 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536210

item.title: Consumer protection: hiding prices carries fines of up to EGP500,000
item.description:
The Consumer Protection Agency renewed its warning against hiding the prices of goods and services behind phrases such as "price in private messages", saying the practice is a legal violation that has spread with social media selling. It said violators face fines of up to EGP500,000 or the value of the product concerned, whichever is greater.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7631751 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7194954

item.title: Awqaf dedicates Friday's second sermon to solidarity after Warraq fire
item.description:
Awqaf Minister Osama El Azhary directed that the second part of tomorrow's Friday sermon address solidarity and compassion in times of crisis, in light of the Warraq Ring Road fire. The ministry said Egyptians standing by one another in hardship reflects national awareness and social solidarity.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536183 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195093

item.title: Central bank offers EGP95bn in treasury bills today
item.description:
The Central Bank of Egypt, in coordination with the finance ministry, is offering EGP95bn in treasury bills on Thursday in two tranches: EGP25bn for 182 days and EGP70bn for 364 days, to finance the budget deficit. The offer follows the Monetary Policy Committee's 29 October decision to raise the overnight deposit and lending rates to 20% and 21%.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536171 · Banker https://www.banker.news/162957

item.title: Egyptian 21-carat gold steady at EGP5,480 after sharp global drop
item.description:
The price of 21-carat gold, the most traded in Egypt, held at EGP5,480 a gram on Thursday after a sharp fall yesterday in line with a more than 3% drop in global prices. The decline followed the US personal consumption expenditures index rising to 3.8% year on year in October, reinforcing expectations of US rate hikes.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/26/x/7625985 · Banker https://www.banker.news/162938

item.title: Bank of Korea raises rate to 3.25% and lifts growth forecasts
item.description:
The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point to 3.25% on Thursday, the highest since October 2024, resuming tightening after an October pause. It cited inflation above its 2% target driven by higher oil prices, and strong growth led by AI demand for chips. The bank raised its growth forecasts for 2026 and 2027 to 3.9% and 4.1%.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/bank-of-korea-raises-key-rate-to-325-to-curb-inflationary-pressure · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/26/south-koreas-central-bank-hikes-interest-rates-raises-gdp-growth-forecast

item.title: Poland plans a no-fly zone along its border with Ukraine
item.description:
Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk said the government is preparing a decree to create a no-fly zone near the border with Ukraine, due to take effect at the end of December or in early January, after repeated airspace violations Warsaw blames on Russia. The zone aims to let Polish forces track and, if necessary, shoot down Russian military aircraft, and Tomczyk denied Warsaw would seek NATO permission.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/poland-vows-to-create-no-fly-zone-along-border-with-ukraine · Asharq Al-Awsat (AFP) https://aawsat.com/node/5345684

item.title: Israel says it killed Hamas economic chief Khaled Abu Nada
item.description:
The Israeli military said it killed Khaled Abu Nada, head of the economic department in Hamas's political bureau and deputy education minister in Gaza, in a strike on Deir al-Balah on Wednesday evening. Gaza's education ministry mourned him and his wife. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz vowed that Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya would be next.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536188 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195070

item.title: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares to every US child
item.description:
Elon Musk pledged on Wednesday to give every child in the United States two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from him personally, a gift he valued at about $18bn. The company said it would donate one newly issued Class A share to every active account in the government-backed Trump Accounts savings programme for children, and Musk said the shares would be transferred next month.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/elon-musk-pledges-18-billion-in-spacex-shares-to-us-children-1.500761648 · Asharq Al-Awsat (Reuters) https://aawsat.com/node/5345806

item.title: Oil extends gains for a second day with Brent near $95
item.description:
Oil prices rose for a second day on Thursday morning, with Brent at $95.31 a barrel and US crude near $84, after gains of nearly 6% over the previous two sessions. Prices were supported by Houthi claims of a strike on the Ras Tanura refinery, disrupted shipping through Hormuz, and a smaller-than-expected 1.1-million-barrel rise in US inventories.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/26/oil-rebounds-to-95-per-barrel-after-saudi-refinery-attack/ · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/oil-prices-rise-on-supply-concerns · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7195128

item.title: Gold steadies at $3,580 after its lowest level in over a year
item.description:
Spot gold held at $3,580.87 an ounce on Thursday after falling below $3,500 yesterday for the first time since September 2025, as hotter-than-expected US inflation data reinforced expectations of rate hikes. US futures rose 1.2% to $3,578.70, and silver gained 1% to $41.64.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/26/gold-steadies-after-plunging-to-more-than-one-year-low · Oman Daily https://www.omandaily.om/article/1215721
